system.description:
Favored by many hunters and snipers.

Negative Traits: Loud

Concealability: None

Damage: Two health levels

Availability: Any, if registered; Police 4, Street 4, or Underworld 3 otherwise.

Special Ability - High-Caliber: May be loaded with high-caliber ammunition (must be specifically acquired - not included automatically).
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Rules, Systems and Drama
